summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the need to separate development environments. Currently, two versions (one for analytics and one for data-api) are deployed to staging, which is inefficient.

**Decisions/Plans:**
*   The current setup requires merging the two existing versions into a single deployment.
*   A plan was established to formally define and begin separating the environments today.
decisions: Merge the analytics and data-api versions currently deployed on staging.
action_items: Define and start separating development environments (environments separation) today.
